implementation.atomicity: validate against the parent session without writes; execute in one child session; merge once on success; revoke on error or drop

contracts.name: AccountCreateContract
rules: default owner and active permissions iff ALLOW_MULTI_SIGN=1

contracts.name: AccountUpdateContract
rules: ALLOW_UPDATE_ACCOUNT_NAME controls repeated and duplicate names

contracts.name: AccountPermissionUpdateContract
rules: witness required exactly for witness accounts
permission name <=32 Java UTF-16 code units
active operations exactly 32 bytes and a subset of AVAILABLE_CONTRACT_TYPE
execution assigns IDs 0, 1, and 2+ in list order

contracts.name: TransferContract
contracts.fee: TRANSFER_FEE(0) plus CREATE_NEW_ACCOUNT_FEE_IN_SYSTEM_CONTRACT for an absent recipient
rules: absent recipient becomes Normal at latest-header time with optional defaults
ALLOW_TVM_COMPATIBLE_EVM rejects version-one contract destinations and requires their Contract row

wire.input_any: the original Any, including raw value bytes and unknown fields, remains available through raw_any
wire.stored_protobuf: account and contract rows use canonical prost encoding after mutation
